simpson_paradox: Report full train953 and hard192, disjoint sampler lanes, separate completion/admission stages. Tags overlap.
ecological_fallacy: Historical failure rates guide task sampling only; not attributed to all user requests or a single checkpoint.
berkson_selection: Hardness selected on historical training receipts; parent912 selected retrospectively on reused Final200. Confirmation set frozen before new model results.
collider_bias: Conditioning on failure and at least one success is explicit. Persistent failures remain background, not removed from train.
base_rate_neglect: 953 full tasks, 228 eligible, 192 injected, 162 persistent failures and615 invalid trajectories all accounted for.
regression_to_mean: No guarantee high historical failure repeats at912, or that peak912 is repeatable; unchanged-scheduler control planned.
survivorship_bias: Invalid rewards do not contribute failure evidence, but all counts retained. Full native batches still skip without assigning rewards.
look_elsewhere: One frozen pool/mixture pair and fixed maximum budget. No confirmation-driven checkpoint search.
forking_paths: Initial failure-only pool preserved as screening; success requirement finalized before GPU. Both exact manifests available, only learnable used.
causation: Mining tags are observational proxies, not causal error diagnoses; A/B changes sampler fraction only.
reverse_causality: Historical difficulty is used prospectively; no improvement or training-cause claim before experiments.
